atoms.name: bit_and
atoms.rule: a ∧ b is bitwise AND on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain: a ∧ b is bitwise AND on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain_zh: a ∧ b 是两个非负整数的按位与。

atoms.name: bit_or
atoms.rule: a ∨ b is bitwise OR on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain: a ∨ b is bitwise OR on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain_zh: a ∨ b 是两个非负整数的按位或。

atoms.name: bit_xor
atoms.rule: a ⊻ b is bitwise XOR on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain: a ⊻ b is bitwise XOR on nonnegative integers.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⊻ b 是两个非负整数的按位异或。

atoms.name: shift_left
atoms.rule: a ⇐ b shifts nonnegative a left by b bits; counts above 31 give NaN.
atoms.plain: a ⇐ b shifts nonnegative a left by b bits; counts above 31 give NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇐ b 把非负整数 a 左移 b 位，b 大于 31 时得 NaN。

atoms.name: shift_right
atoms.rule: a ⇒ b shifts nonnegative a right by b bits.
atoms.plain: a ⇒ b shifts nonnegative a right by b bits.
atoms.plain_zh: a ⇒ b 把非负整数 a 右移 b 位。

atoms.name: bit_count
atoms.rule: a ♯ counts the one bits of nonnegative a; negative inputs give NaN.
atoms.plain: a ♯ counts the one bits of nonnegative a; negative inputs give NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a ♯ 是非负整数 a 的二进制里 1 的个数。

domain.en: Values are nonnegative integers read as bit patterns; the lamps show the lowest eight bits.
domain.zh: 取值是看作二进制位的非负整数，灯显示最低 8 位。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms and defaults.
settings.zh: 选择这些原子和默认设置的预设。

settings.en: A recursive call unfolds at most this many times; larger counters give NaN.
settings.zh: 递归最多展开这么多次，更大的计数得 NaN。

settings.en: The range of numbers in generated expressions and branch thresholds.
settings.zh: 生成算式和分支阈值所用的数值范围。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♤₁
operators.definition: a ♤₁ b = { ▲₈ (b ⊻ a) }
operators.plain: XOR b with a bit by bit, then apply ▲₈ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 b 与 a 按位异或，再对结果应用 ▲₈。

operators.name: ♡₂
operators.definition: a ♡₂ b = { a ▼₉, if a < 5 and b >= 17 and b < 18; b ⇐ 4, else }
operators.plain: If a < 5 and b ≥ 17 and b < 18, apply ▼₉ to a; otherwise shift b left by 4 bits.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 5 且 b ≥ 17 且 b < 18，对 a 应用 ▼₉；否则把 b 左移 4 位。

operators.name: ♢₃
operators.definition: a ♢₃ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♢₃ (b ⇒ 1)) ∨ b, if b > 0 and b <= 31 }
operators.plain: Starting from a, OR in b and its successive right shifts until b reaches zero (b from 0 to 31).
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归（b 取 0 到 31）：b = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 b ⇒ 1 的结果 r，再把 r 与 b 按位或。

operators.name: △₄
operators.definition: a △₄ = { a ⇐ a }
operators.plain: Shift a left by a bits.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 左移 a 位。

operators.name: ♦₅
operators.plain: Count the one bits of b, then OR it with the number of one bits in a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 b 的二进制里有几个 1，再把结果与「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」按位或。

operators.name: □₆
operators.plain: Apply △₄ to b, then AND it with the number of one bits in a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 △₄，再把结果与「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」按位与。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ●₇
operators.definition: a ●₇ = { a ♦₅ 1 }
operators.plain: Compute a ♦₅ 1.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 1 应用 ♦₅。

operators.name: ▲₈
operators.plain: Count the one bits of a, then shift it left by a ●₇ bits.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再把结果左移 a ●₇ 位。

operators.name: ▼₉
operators.plain: Apply ●₇ to a, then apply ♦₅ to the result and (the number of one bits in a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ●₇，再对结果和「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」应用 ♦₅。

operators.name: □₁₀
operators.definition: □₁₀ a = { a ♦₅ (a ●₇) }
operators.plain: Apply ♦₅ to a and (a ●₇).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ●₇ 应用 ♦₅。

operators.name: △₁₁
operators.definition: a △₁₁ b = { (b ●₇) ⇐ (a ●₇) }
operators.plain: Apply ●₇ to b, then shift it left by a ●₇ bits.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ●₇，再把结果左移 a ●₇ 位。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ◇₁₂
operators.definition: a ◇₁₂ = { (a ▼₉) ∨ a }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₉ to a, then OR it with a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₉，再把结果与 a 按位或。

operators.name: ■₁₃
operators.definition: a ■₁₃ = { (▲₈ 4) △₁₁ a }
operators.plain: Apply ▲₈ to 4, then apply △₁₁ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 4 应用 ▲₈，再对结果和 a 应用 △₁₁。

operators.name: ★₁₄
operators.definition: ★₁₄ a = { a ♤₁ (a ▼₉) }
operators.plain: Apply ♤₁ to a and (a ▼₉).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ▼₉ 应用 ♤₁。

operators.name: ★₁₅
operators.plain: Apply ★₁₄ to a, then OR it with the number of one bits in a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ★₁₄，再把结果与「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」按位或。

operators.name: ♤₁₆
operators.definition: ♤₁₆ a = { (a △₄) ⊻ (★₁₄ a) }
operators.plain: Apply △₄ to a, then XOR it with ★₁₄ a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 △₄，再把结果与 ★₁₄ a 按位异或。

operators.name: ▽₁₇
operators.definition: a ▽₁₇ b = { (a ▼₉) △₁₁ (▲₈ b) }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₉ to a, then apply △₁₁ to the result and (▲₈ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₉，再对结果和 ▲₈ b 应用 △₁₁。

operators.name: ♤₁₈
operators.definition: ♤₁₈ a = { (a △₄) ⇒ a }
operators.plain: Apply △₄ to a, then shift it right by a bits.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 △₄，再把结果右移 a 位。

operators.name: ♥₁₉
operators.definition: a ♥₁₉ b = { b ♦₅ (21 △₄), if a >= 22 and b >= 9 and b < 14; (♤₁₆ b) ⊻ (♤₁₆ b), if a >= 20 and a < 22 and b >= 9 and b < 14; (b △₄) ⊻ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 22 and b ≥ 9 and b < 14, apply ♦₅ to b and (21 △₄); otherwise if 20 ≤ a < 22 and b ≥ 9 and b < 14, apply ♤₁₆ to b, then XOR the result with itself bit by bit; otherwise apply △₄ to b, then XOR it with b bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 22 且 b ≥ 9 且 b < 14，对 b 和 21 △₄ 应用 ♦₅；否则若 20 ≤ a < 22 且 b ≥ 9 且 b < 14，先对 b 应用 ♤₁₆，再把结果与结果按位异或；否则先对 b 应用 △₄，再把结果与 b 按位异或。

operators.name: ○₂₀
operators.definition: a ○₂₀ b = { (b ■₁₃) ♤₁ (★₁₄ b), if a < 20 and b >= 13 and b < 23; (23 ▼₉) ∧ (♤₁₆ b), if a < 20 and b >= 23; (★₁₄ a) △₁₁ (a ■₁₃), else }
operators.plain: If a < 20 and b ≥ 13 and b < 23, apply ■₁₃ to b, then apply ♤₁ to the result and (★₁₄ b); otherwise if a < 20 and b ≥ 23, apply ▼₉ to 23, then AND it with ♤₁₆ b bit by bit; otherwise apply ★₁₄ to a, then apply △₁₁ to the result and (a ■₁₃).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 20 且 b ≥ 13 且 b < 23，先对 b 应用 ■₁₃，再对结果和 ★₁₄ b 应用 ♤₁；否则若 a < 20 且 b ≥ 23，先对 23 应用 ▼₉，再把结果与 ♤₁₆ b 按位与；否则先对 a 应用 ★₁₄，再对结果和 a ■₁₃ 应用 △₁₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♠₂₁
operators.definition: ♠₂₁ a = { a, if a >= 17; (13 ◇₁₂) △₁₁ (a ●₇), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 17, return a; otherwise apply ◇₁₂ to 13, then apply △₁₁ to the result and (a ●₇).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 17，结果为 a；否则先对 13 应用 ◇₁₂，再对结果和 a ●₇ 应用 △₁₁。

operators.name: ◇₂₂
operators.definition: a ◇₂₂ b = { ♠₂₁ 12, if a < 13 and b < 8; 12 ♦₅ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 13 and b < 8, apply ♠₂₁ to 12; otherwise compute 12 ♦₅ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 13 且 b < 8，对 12 应用 ♠₂₁；否则对 12 和 b 应用 ♦₅。

operators.name: ▼₂₃
operators.definition: a ▼₂₃ = { (▲₈ a) ○₂₀ (a ★₁₅), if a >= 29; a ▽₁₇ (□₁₀ 1), if a < 6; (▲₈ a) ∧ (★₁₄ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 29, apply ▲₈ to a, then apply ○₂₀ to the result and (a ★₁₅); otherwise if a < 6, apply ▽₁₇ to a and (□₁₀ 1); otherwise apply ▲₈ to a, then AND it with ★₁₄ a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 29，先对 a 应用 ▲₈，再对结果和 a ★₁₅ 应用 ○₂₀；否则若 a < 6，对 a 和 □₁₀ 1 应用 ▽₁₇；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₈，再把结果与 ★₁₄ a 按位与。

operators.name: ▽₂₄
operators.definition: a ▽₂₄ b = { (♠₂₁ b) ♥₁₉ (□₁₀ a), if a >= 20 and a < 25 and b >= 16; (♤₁₆ a) ♯, else }
operators.plain: If 20 ≤ a < 25 and b ≥ 16, apply ♠₂₁ to b, then apply ♥₁₉ to the result and (□₁₀ a); otherwise apply ♤₁₆ to a, then count its one bits.
operators.plain_zh: 若 20 ≤ a < 25 且 b ≥ 16，先对 b 应用 ♠₂₁，再对结果和 □₁₀ a 应用 ♥₁₉；否则先对 a 应用 ♤₁₆，再数结果的二进制里有几个 1。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♦₂₅
operators.definition: a ♦₂₅ = { a ♤₁ a, if a >= 10; a □₆ a, if a >= 4 and a < 10; a △₄, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10, compute a ♤₁ a; otherwise if 4 ≤ a < 10, compute a □₆ a; otherwise apply △₄ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₁；否则若 4 ≤ a < 10，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 □₆；否则对 a 应用 △₄。

operators.name: ▽₂₆
operators.definition: ▽₂₆ a = { □₁₀ (a ♥₁₉ a), if a >= 31; a ∨ (♠₂₁ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 31, apply ♥₁₉ to a and a, then apply □₁₀ to the result; otherwise OR a with ♠₂₁ a bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 31，先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♥₁₉，再对结果应用 □₁₀；否则把 a 与 ♠₂₁ a 按位或。

operators.name: ▲₂₇
operators.definition: a ▲₂₇ b = { ▲₈ a, if a < 20 and b >= 30; 3 △₁₁ a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 20 and b ≥ 30, apply ▲₈ to a; otherwise compute 3 △₁₁ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 20 且 b ≥ 30，对 a 应用 ▲₈；否则对 3 和 a 应用 △₁₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ▲₂₈
operators.definition: a ▲₂₈ b = { ▲₈ 3, if a < 15 and b >= 5 and b < 11; a ⇐ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 15 and b ≥ 5 and b < 11, apply ▲₈ to 3; otherwise shift a left by b bits.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 15 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 11，对 3 应用 ▲₈；否则把 a 左移 b 位。

operators.name: ♣₂₉
operators.definition: a ♣₂₉ b = { 21 ♦₅ 11, if a < 22 and b >= 2 and b < 3; (b ▲₂₈ a) ♦₂₅, else }
operators.plain: If a < 22 and b ≥ 2 and b < 3, compute 21 ♦₅ 11; otherwise apply ▲₂₈ to b and a, then apply ♦₂₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 22 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 3，对 21 和 11 应用 ♦₅；否则先对 b 和 a 应用 ▲₂₈，再对结果应用 ♦₂₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♠₃₀
operators.definition: a ♠₃₀ = { (a ▼₂₃) ⇐ (a ▼₂₃) }
operators.plain: Apply ▼₂₃ to a, then shift the result left by itself bits.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₂₃，再把结果左移结果位。

operators.name: ■₃₁
operators.definition: a ■₃₁ = { (a ♦₂₅) ○₂₀ (▽₂₆ a), if a >= 3 and a < 4; (a ●₇) ♡₂ (a ▼₉), else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 4, apply ♦₂₅ to a, then apply ○₂₀ to the result and (▽₂₆ a); otherwise apply ●₇ to a, then apply ♡₂ to the result and (a ▼₉).
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 4，先对 a 应用 ♦₂₅，再对结果和 ▽₂₆ a 应用 ○₂₀；否则先对 a 应用 ●₇，再对结果和 a ▼₉ 应用 ♡₂。

operators.name: ♦₃₂
operators.definition: a ♦₃₂ = { (a ♦₂₅) ♡₂ (a ♯) }
operators.plain: Apply ♦₂₅ to a, then apply ♡₂ to the result and (the number of one bits in a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♦₂₅，再对结果和「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」应用 ♡₂。

operators.name: △₃₃
operators.definition: a △₃₃ b = { ▽₂₆ a, if a >= 18 and a < 25 and b >= 2; b ♥₁₉ b, if a >= 9 and a < 18 and b < 1; ▽₂₆ b, else }
operators.plain: If 18 ≤ a < 25 and b ≥ 2, apply ▽₂₆ to a; otherwise if 9 ≤ a < 18 and b < 1, compute b ♥₁₉ b; otherwise apply ▽₂₆ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 18 ≤ a < 25 且 b ≥ 2，对 a 应用 ▽₂₆；否则若 9 ≤ a < 18 且 b < 1，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ♥₁₉；否则对 b 应用 ▽₂₆。

operators.name: ☆₃₄
operators.definition: a ☆₃₄ = { a, if a < 11; ♤₁₈ (★₁₄ a), if a >= 31; (a ◇₁₂) ♣₂₉ (▲₈ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 11, return a; otherwise if a ≥ 31, apply ★₁₄ to a, then apply ♤₁₈ to the result; otherwise apply ◇₁₂ to a, then apply ♣₂₉ to the result and (▲₈ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 11，结果为 a；否则若 a ≥ 31，先对 a 应用 ★₁₄，再对结果应用 ♤₁₈；否则先对 a 应用 ◇₁₂，再对结果和 ▲₈ a 应用 ♣₂₉。

operators.name: ♣₃₅
operators.definition: a ♣₃₅ b = { (□₁₀ a) ♦₅ (♤₁₆ b) }
operators.plain: Apply □₁₀ to a, then apply ♦₅ to the result and (♤₁₆ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 □₁₀，再对结果和 ♤₁₆ b 应用 ♦₅。

operators.name: ☆₃₆
operators.definition: ☆₃₆ a = { a ⊻ a, if a >= 19 and a < 24; (▲₈ a) △₃₃ (a ●₇), else }
operators.plain: If 19 ≤ a < 24, XOR a with a bit by bit; otherwise apply ▲₈ to a, then apply △₃₃ to the result and (a ●₇).
operators.plain_zh: 若 19 ≤ a < 24，把 a 与 a 按位异或；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₈，再对结果和 a ●₇ 应用 △₃₃。

operators.name: ♢₃₇
operators.definition: a ♢₃₇ = { a ♦₅ (□₁₀ a), if a < 7; 17 △₁₁ 3, else }
operators.plain: If a < 7, apply ♦₅ to a and (□₁₀ a); otherwise compute 17 △₁₁ 3.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 7，对 a 和 □₁₀ a 应用 ♦₅；否则对 17 和 3 应用 △₁₁。

operators.name: ☆₃₈
operators.definition: a ☆₃₈ b = { (a ♠₃₀) ⇐ b }
operators.plain: Apply ♠₃₀ to a, then shift it left by b bits.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♠₃₀，再把结果左移 b 位。

operators.name: ▽₃₉
operators.definition: a ▽₃₉ b = { ♤₁₈ b, if a >= 1 and a < 9 and b >= 0 and b < 27; b ⊻ b, else }
operators.plain: If 1 ≤ a < 9 and b ≥ 0 and b < 27, apply ♤₁₈ to b; otherwise XOR b with b bit by bit.
operators.plain_zh: 若 1 ≤ a < 9 且 b ≥ 0 且 b < 27，对 b 应用 ♤₁₈；否则把 b 与 b 按位异或。

operators.name: ●₄₀
operators.definition: a ●₄₀ = { (a ♠₃₀) △₁₁ (a ★₁₅), if a >= 25; (a ♯) ♡₂ (▲₈ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 25, apply ♠₃₀ to a, then apply △₁₁ to the result and (a ★₁₅); otherwise count the one bits of a, then apply ♡₂ to the result and (▲₈ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 25，先对 a 应用 ♠₃₀，再对结果和 a ★₁₅ 应用 △₁₁；否则先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再对结果和 ▲₈ a 应用 ♡₂。

operators.name: ☆₄₁
operators.definition: ☆₄₁ a = { a ∨ (▲₈ a), if a < 1; (★₁₄ a) ◇₂₂ (3 ♦₂₅), if a >= 12 and a < 29; (▲₈ a) ♦₂₅, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, OR a with ▲₈ a bit by bit; otherwise if 12 ≤ a < 29, apply ★₁₄ to a, then apply ◇₂₂ to the result and (3 ♦₂₅); otherwise apply ▲₈ to a, then apply ♦₂₅ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，把 a 与 ▲₈ a 按位或；否则若 12 ≤ a < 29，先对 a 应用 ★₁₄，再对结果和 3 ♦₂₅ 应用 ◇₂₂；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₈，再对结果应用 ♦₂₅。

operators.name: ◆₄₂
operators.definition: a ◆₄₂ b = { b, if a == 0; ((a ⇒ 1) ◆₄₂ b) ▽₂₄ a, if a > 0 and a <= 31 }
operators.plain: Recurse on a (for a from 0 to 31): when a = 0 the result is b; otherwise let r be the result for a ⇒ 1, then apply ▽₂₄ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归（a 取 0 到 31）：a = 0 时结果为 b；否则先求 a ⇒ 1 的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 ▽₂₄。

operators.name: ♧₄₃
operators.definition: a ♧₄₃ b = { b, if a == 0; ((a ⇒ 1) ♧₄₃ b) ♠₃₀, if a > 0 and a <= 31 }
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat once for each right shift of a until it reaches 0 (for a from 0 to 31): apply ♠₃₀ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，a 每右移一位（直到变成 0）就做一次：对结果应用 ♠₃₀（a 取 0 到 31）。

operators.name: △₄₄
operators.definition: a △₄₄ b = { b, if a == 0; ♤₁₈ ((a ⇒ 1) △₄₄ b), if a > 0 and a <= 31 }
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat once for each right shift of a until it reaches 0 (for a from 0 to 31): apply ♤₁₈ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，a 每右移一位（直到变成 0）就做一次：对结果应用 ♤₁₈（a 取 0 到 31）。

operators.name: ◇₄₅
operators.definition: ◇₄₅ a = { a, if a == 0; (◇₄₅ (a ⇒ 1)) ▽₁₇ a, if a > 0 and a <= 31 }
operators.plain: Recurse on a (for a from 0 to 31): when a = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for a ⇒ 1, then apply ▽₁₇ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归（a 取 0 到 31）：a = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 a ⇒ 1 的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 ▽₁₇。

operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归（a 取 0 到 31）：a = 0 时结果为 0；否则先求 a ⇒ 1 的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ◇₂₂ r。

operators.plain: Recurse on b (for b from 0 to 31): when b = 0 the result is 0; otherwise let r be the result for b ⇒ 1, then replace r by b ♤₁ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归（b 取 0 到 31）：b = 0 时结果为 0；否则先求 b ⇒ 1 的结果 r，再把 r 换成 b ♤₁ r。

operators.definition: a ▼₉₇ b = { b ▽₂₄ b, if a >= 13 and a < 19 and b < 4; b ◇₈₅, else }
operators.plain: If 13 ≤ a < 19 and b < 4, compute b ▽₂₄ b; otherwise apply ◇₈₅ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 13 ≤ a < 19 且 b < 4，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₂₄；否则对 b 应用 ◇₈₅。

operators.name: ♧₉₈
operators.definition: a ♧₉₈ = { a ♢₉₂ a, if a < 1; a ♢₃ a, if a >= 6; 6 ♥₁₉ 4, else }
operators.plain: If a < 1, compute a ♢₉₂ a; otherwise if a ≥ 6, compute a ♢₃ a; otherwise compute 6 ♥₁₉ 4.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♢₉₂；否则若 a ≥ 6，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♢₃；否则对 6 和 4 应用 ♥₁₉。

operators.name: ▼₉₉
operators.definition: a ▼₉₉ b = { a ♦₄₉ (●₉₁ b), if a < 30 and b < 7; a ◇₂₂ (□₁₀ 1), if a >= 30 and b >= 15 and b < 18; a ♡₈₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 30 and b < 7, apply ♦₄₉ to a and (●₉₁ b); otherwise if a ≥ 30 and b ≥ 15 and b < 18, apply ◇₂₂ to a and (□₁₀ 1); otherwise compute a ♡₈₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 30 且 b < 7，对 a 和 ●₉₁ b 应用 ♦₄₉；否则若 a ≥ 30 且 b ≥ 15 且 b < 18，对 a 和 □₁₀ 1 应用 ◇₂₂；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♡₈₁。

operators.name: ♥₁₀₀
operators.definition: ♥₁₀₀ a = { a, if a >= 10 and a < 14; (a ■₃₁) ♢₉₂ (▼₆₁ a), if a >= 28; (▲₈ a) ♡₂ (△₆₉ a), else }
operators.plain: If 10 ≤ a < 14, return a; otherwise if a ≥ 28, apply ■₃₁ to a, then apply ♢₉₂ to the result and (▼₆₁ a); otherwise apply ▲₈ to a, then apply ♡₂ to the result and (△₆₉ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 10 ≤ a < 14，结果为 a；否则若 a ≥ 28，先对 a 应用 ■₃₁，再对结果和 ▼₆₁ a 应用 ♢₉₂；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₈，再对结果和 △₆₉ a 应用 ♡₂。
